blocks.text: The Council declares it to be necessary to exercise the City’s police power pursuant to K.S.A. 8-2002(a)(3) and establish procedures and regulations relating to funeral processions on the streets and highways of the City. (Code 1981 § 46-131. Code 1995 § 154-191.)
